title: Keizan's Zazen Yojinki, Part 2
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The talk emphasizes the importance of cultivating clarity and inner stillness as the path to liberation from desire and attachment. By letting go of our grasping for external circumstances and focusing on our own inner peace, we can experience a sense of freedom and acceptance that allows us to see through life's challenges with clarity. This requires embracing simplicity and mindfulness in our daily lives, aligning our actions with the principles of Zen practice, and approaching each moment with an open and present mindset.
